ports.name: clk_i
ports.function: module receives global clock; synchronizes reset logic
ports.evidence: used in rising_edge(clk_i) in sequencer and synchronizer processes

ports.name: rstn_ext_i
ports.function: module receives async external reset input (low-active)

relationship.object: external reset output and sequencer registers

ports.name: rstn_wdt_i
ports.function: module receives watchdog reset input; used to trigger system reset

relationship.object: system reset sequencer and watchdog processor reset

ports.name: rstn_dbg_i
ports.function: module receives debugger reset input; used to trigger system reset

relationship.object: system reset sequencer and debugger processor reset

ports.name: rstn_ext_o
ports.function: module drives synchronized external reset output (low-active)

ports.name: rstn_sys_o
ports.function: module drives synchronized system reset output (low-active)

ports.name: xrstn_wdt_o
ports.function: module drives processor watchdog reset output, synchronized

ports.name: xrstn_ocd_o
ports.function: module drives processor debugger reset output, synchronized

ports.name: clk_i
ports.function: receives global clock; clocks internal sequential logic (module input)
ports.evidence: used in rising_edge(clk_i) in ticker and other processes

ports.name: rstn_i
ports.function: receives low-active async reset; resets internal state (module input)

ports.name: enable_i
ports.function: receives enable vector; gates tick counter when high (module input)
ports.evidence: en <= or_reduce_f(enable_i); cnt increments only if en = '1'

ports.name: clk_en_o
ports.function: drives clock-enable tick outputs; pulses high for one cycle
ports.evidence: clk_en_o(... ) <= cnt(n) and (not cnt2(n)); one-cycle rising-edge detector

signals.name: sreg_sys
signals.function: Shift register synchronizing internal resets, generates rstn_sys_o
signals.evidence: cleared on rstn_wdt_i/'0' or rstn_dbg_i/'0'; rstn_sys_o <= and_reduce_f(sreg_sys)

signals.name: sreg_ext
signals.function: Shift register synchronizing external reset, generates rstn_ext_o

signals.name: en
signals.function: global enable indicator; true if any enable_i bit asserted

signals.name: cnt2
signals.function: previous-cycle copy of cnt for rising-edge detection
signals.evidence: cnt2 <= cnt; used in clk_en_o as cnt(i) and (not cnt2(i))
